skills.name: netfluid
skills.description: AI agent banking for autonomous AI agents - open virtual bank accounts, send/receive global payments (SEPA/ACH/WIRE), manage crypto wallets (USDC, SOL, ETH), on/off-ramp between fiat and crypto. Supports ZAR, USD, EUR.

requirements.api_key: Required - from Netfluid app Settings → API Keys
requirements.session_token: Required - from single-use session_key via Netfluid app

security_model.credentials_transient: API keys and tokens used only for API calls, not stored
security_model.audit_trail: All operations logged by Netfluid API

skills.pricing: Free API key from Netfluid app. Transaction fees may apply.
